The model may be applied to any combination of ion and redshift if the galaxy stellar mass function is well-constrained. Future observational tests incorporating improved host statistics will extend the model's range.

title: High-contrast aperture masking interferometry: detecting companions within the diffraction limit
background_knowledge: 直接成像与表征类地系外行星是当前天文观测的重要前沿。传统的高衬度成像技术依赖日冕仪来压制中心恒星的光芒，但由于受限于望远镜的衍射极限（通常只能在角距离大于 $2\lambda/D$ 的区域探测伴星），很难直接观测到极近距离的暗弱伴星。非冗余掩模干涉（NRM）技术利用单孔望远镜配合掩模进行干涉测量，能够在衍射极限之内的角尺度上解析天体特征，但在高衬度观测中面临灵敏度不足的问题。将高衬度日冕仪与 NRM 干涉技术相结合，有望突破传统仪器的内工作角限制，开辟全新的高衬度探测空间。
contribution:
- **提出创新复合架构**：本研究详细探讨了将高衬度日冕仪与非冗余掩模干涉技术相结合的复合光学架构，旨在确定传统高衬度成像内工作角以内目标的性能边界与发现空间。
- **预测衬度性能提升**：理论预测表明，通过结合这两种技术，在光子受限的观测条件下可以显著提升系统可实现的衬度。
- **估算系统技术需求**：开发了针对该复合系统的波前稳定性要求评估，为未来硬件设计与观测方案制定奠定了基础。
summary: The pursuit of the direct discovery and characterization of Earth-like exoplanets has motivated high contrast imaging surveys using coronagraphs with narrow inner working angles. Traditional imaging methods, however, are limited by the size of the on-axis PSF and typically only detect companions at angular separations of > 2$λ$/D. Meanwhile, non-redundant masking (NRM) techniques have been used with single-aperture telescopes to interferometrically resolve astrophysical features at angular scales within the diffraction limit, but NRM interferometry faces sensitivity issues for high-contrast objects. In this project, we investigate utilizing high contrast coronagraphy in conjunction with NRM interferometry. We conduct a preliminary investigation of this combined architecture with the goal of determining the potential bounds of performance and discovery space for high-contrast targets within the inner working angle of traditional high-contrast imaging. We predict an improvement in the achievable contrast for photon-limited observations by combining the techniques, and we also develop estimates for wavefront stability requirements for the system.

title: A Multi-instrument Generalized Lomb-Scargle Periodogram Implementation
background_knowledge: 在现代天文观测中，利用视向速度法探测系外行星时，往往需要联合来自多个不同望远镜或仪器的观测数据。由于不同仪器之间存在系统性的零点偏移，传统方法在处理此类多源异构数据时容易引入误差，进而掩盖微弱的周期信号。
contribution:
- 提出了一种 **多仪器广义 Lomb-Scargle 周期图** 的简单闭式实现方案，能够在算法层面同时考虑并处理不同观测仪器引入的个体零点偏移。
- 将该多仪器 GLS 方法应用于热木星 **TOI-481 b** 的视向速度数据集，成功恢复了其轨道周期。
- 相较于标准 GLS 方法，该方法能够以 **更高的显著性** 恢复目标信号，验证了其处理多仪器观测数据的优越性，相关代码已在 GitHub 开源。
summary: We present an implementation of the well-known and broadly used Generalized Lomb-Scargle Periodogram (GLS) which simultaneously takes into account individual offsets introduced in the data by different instruments: a "multi-instrument" GLS periodogram. While the algorithm itself is not new, the simple closed form implementation we provide, to our knowledge, is. We showcase an application of our multi-instrument GLS on radial-velocity data of the hot Jupiter TOI-481 b, whose period is recovered with a higher significance compared to the standard GLS approach. The code is available on GitHub.

title: Chang'e 7 Lunar Lander Optical Camera-Telescope: Optical Astronomy from the Moon
background_knowledge: 月基天文观测（Lunar-based astronomical observation）依托月球无大气层吸收与扰动、无电离层干扰以及真空环境等得天独厚的优势，成为现代天文学的重要前沿方向。月球极区（特别是月球南极）拥有独特的日照与热环境条件，非常适合建立小型月球天文台，从而开展长期、连续、宽视场的天文监测。该领域的研究有助于填补地面及近地空间望远镜在特定连续观测窗口与大视场巡天上的空白。
contribution:
- 报告了嫦娥七号（Chang'e 7）月球探测任务所搭载的全新轻量化、宽视场光学相机-望远镜的**设计与制造细节**。
- 该仪器作为中国国家航天局（CNSA）小型月球天文观测站计划的一部分，由夏威夷国际月球天文台协会（ILOA）、香港大学太空研究实验室（LSR）以及北京空间机电研究所（BISME）共同合作完成。
- 阐明了相机针对月球南极极端温度环境的适应性设计，确保其能够在月面复杂热环境下实现**可持续的长期天文观测**。
- 结合地面初步性能测试与模拟输出分析，全面评估了该相机凭借适度口径与宽视场，在月球表面进行**实际天体观测的潜力与可行性范围**。
summary: We report the design and manufacture of a new, lightweight, wide-field, optical camera-telescope on board the Chang'e 7 lunar mission (launched in August 2026 and due for lunar touchdown in late November 2026). The camera is capable of static, panchromatic imagery within a $420-696~nm$ optical wavelength range. The camera was designed and built under the small lunar astronomy observation station program of the Chinese National Space Agency (CNSA) as a collaboration between the International Lunar Observatory Association of Hawaii (ILOA), the Laboratory for Space Research (LSR) of the University of Hong Kong (HKU) and the Beijing Institute of Space Mechanics and Electricity (BISME). The camera has been built to meet science goals of the mission for sustainable astronomical operation over a large range of temperatures from the Moon's south pole. We report on the design and ground based preliminary performance, together with an analysis of the camera's simulated output to indicate the range of astronomical observations possible from the lunar surface given the camera's limited sensitivity and angular resolution given the modest aperture and wide field of view.
